scenes.say: What makes data truly trustworthy? Which dimensions of quality should you check?

scenes.label: Accuracy
scenes.sub: Does the data reflect real-world values?
scenes.say: First up, accuracy. Does your data reflect real-world values, or is it off?
Then check completeness, uniqueness, and validity. Are all fields filled, no duplicates, and formats correct?

scenes.title: Customer Table Example
scenes.say: For example, to check completeness, run a query to find missing emails in your customer table.

scenes.question: Is accuracy the only dimension to check?
scenes.right: No, check all dimensions: accuracy, completeness, uniqueness, and validity.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Is accuracy the only thing that matters? Nope. You need to check all the main dimensions.
